description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptDAO component in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing various methods related to concept retrieval, existence checks, and indexing. It extends a base test class to run context-sensitive tests and uses JUnit 5 annotations. The tests validate functionality such as retrieving concept sources, checking usage of concept map types and reference terms, purging concepts, and searching concepts with different filters.

classes.name: ConceptDAOTest
classes.description: A test class for testing the ConceptDAO implementation in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object by fetching it from the application context before each test.

methods.name: AllConceptSources_shouldReturnAllConceptSources
methods.description: Verifies that all concept sources (including retired ones) are returned correctly.

methods.name: AllConceptSources_shouldReturnAllUnretiredConceptSources
methods.description: Verifies that only unretired concept sources are returned.

methods.name: isConceptMapTypeInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfAMapTypeHasAConceptMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Checks that the DAO correctly identifies whether a ConceptMapType is in use.

methods.name: isConceptMapTypeInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfAMapTypeHasAConceptReferenceTermMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Checks usage of a ConceptMapType related to ConceptReferenceTerm mappings.

methods.name: isConceptReferenceTermInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfATermHasAConceptMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Checks whether a ConceptReferenceTerm is in use via concept maps.

methods.name: isConceptReferenceTermInUse_shouldReturnTrueIfATermHasAConceptReferenceTermMapOrMoreUsingIt
methods.description: Checks usage of a ConceptReferenceTerm related to concept reference term maps.

methods.name: isConceptMapTypeInUse_shouldReturnFalseIfAMapTypeHasNoMapsUsingIt
methods.description: Verifies DAO correctly reports no usage when there are no concept maps using the type.

methods.name: isConceptReferenceTermInUse_shouldReturnFalseIfATermHasNoMapsUsingIt
methods.description: Verifies DAO correctly reports no usage for a concept reference term with no maps.

methods.name: purgeConcept_shouldPurgeConcept
methods.description: Tests that a concept can be purged from the database.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldNotReturnConceptsWithMatchingNamesThatAreVoided
methods.description: Ensures that voided concepts are not returned by the search function.

methods.name: getConceptsByAnswer_shouldReturnConceptsForTheGivenAnswerConcept
methods.description: Checks retrieval of concepts based on answer concepts.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldReturnCorrectResultsForConceptWithNamesThatContainsWordsWithMoreWeight
methods.description: Verifies concept search prioritizes names with higher weights.

methods.name: getConcepts_shouldReturnCorrectResultsIfAConceptNameContainsSameWordMoreThanOnce
methods.description: Tests handling of concept names containing repeated words.
